scope: Bounded PARITY-AVAIL-02 follow-up to #1948: distinguish a deliberately omitted unsupported-engine capability from a false claim about missing or lost player research

source_path.space_age_delta: modern_catalogue.select applies the Space Age additions for active space-age, before applying supported_definitions
source_path.f200_gate: targets/editions.json f200.cargo_research=false; supports_family excludes exactly both listed cargo keys; setting_definitions uses the same filter
source_path.f210_gate: targets/editions.json f210.cargo_research=true, so this specific filter does not exclude either key; other admission/generator effects are not inferred
source_path.library: research.catalogue uses selected.definitions as its authored public descriptor list, not as an omission ledger
source_path.availability: presentation.availability.rows with Space Age present, no captured native owner and no Bob closure returns no explanations for these two F200 engine-gated families

f210.interpretation: No not-added explanation is expected merely because two source definitions are supported; presence/emission must be independently established

classification.fact: This is a concrete bounded F200 capability exclusion not described in the finite Availability explanations, even when Space Age is active.
classification.nonfinding: The 2.0 engine lacks these 2.1 native modifiers; this omission is intentional and is NOT evidence that a user was promised cargo research, that MIR deleted an earned technology, or that MIR4 itself supported these 2.1-specific families.
classification.product_decision: Specify whether Availability intentionally excludes unsupported-engine capabilities from its not-added explanations; if so retain an explicit scope exception. Do not claim a complete omitted-stream ledger or add a misleading not-added row that implies a missing user entitlement.
classification.acceptance: If capability exclusions are in scope, introduce a separately designed, source-grounded reason distinct from user-disabled/foreign-owner/absent-DLC; qualify actual F200/F210 native display and client/UI state without touching historical saves.

verification.method: Read-only exact GitHub blob inspection and fixed structural predicates; no Lua or Factorio engine execution

ownership.changes: One additive evidence JSON only; no changes to player code or claimed implementation
ownership.retained: Black Glass owns integration/native/publication/worker-history. Aero owns Linux adapter/probe. Existing published 5.0.14, accepted Angel/agriculture/A612 and native migration evidence are reused without reruns.

gates_open: MIR4 Library design and tab geometry
historical earned/partial/queue/bonus preservation with ordinary completion/save/two colds where applicable
